title: City of Miami Beach Approves GTA6 Marketing Campaign Negotiations
description: The City of Miami Beach has approved negotiations with Rockstar Games for a multi-million dollar GTA6 advertising campaign with discreet placement.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Miami Beach Approves Rockstar Games Negotiations

According to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the City of Miami Beach has officially approved negotiations with Rockstar Games regarding an upcoming marketing campaign for Grand Theft Auto 6.

This potential multi-million dollar deal would bring advertisements for the highly anticipated title directly into the seaside city. However, reports indicate that the brand will only be allowed to appear "discreetly," balancing the influx of substantial funding with the aesthetic and regulatory demands of the city.

## A Fitting Backdrop for the Next-Gen Open World

Given that the fictional setting of Vice City in the franchise is heavily inspired by Miami, a real-world advertising campaign in the actual city carries a strong thematic connection. Rockstar has a history of ambitious and attention-grabbing marketing strategies for its major releases, and securing a presence in Miami Beach marks another significant step in the buildup to the game's launch.

While the exact details of how and where these advertisements will manifest remain subject to ongoing negotiations, the multi-million dollar valuation highlights the massive commercial scope surrounding the project.

## Editor's Take

The approval of negotiations between Miami Beach and Rockstar Games underscores the monumental cultural and commercial footprint of GTA6. While millions of dollars are on the line, the stipulation for "discreet" placement shows that city officials are treading carefully. It is a fascinating intersection of real-world urban management and gaming marketing history.
